# King University Online

> King University Online is a flexible, Christian-focused online university in Tennessee serving working adults and military-connected students with accelerated degree programs and comprehensive support services.

King University Online offers accredited online degree programs including social work (BSW, MSW) and other fields designed for working professionals. The institution is military-friendly, supports transfer credit, and serves first-generation students through flexible learning formats.
